Class ACQ_Scope

  • java.lang.Object
    • ag.ACQ_Scope
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Iterable<java.lang.Integer>

    public final class ACQ_Scope
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.lang.Iterable<java.lang.Integer>
    The scope of a constraint is a set of variables (one or more) that are involved in the constraint. More generally, the scope of a network is all the variables used among all the constraints of the network.
